pcb_thickness_reason: At 1.6mm board plus tolerance the minimum 1.60mm solder tail may not protrude. A 1.0mm board leaves a practical solder-tail allowance. Enclosure must support the thinner strip.
assembly_orientation_proposal: Probes on battery-facing B side, other components mainly outward F side. Through-hole solder lands must be clear on F side.

battery_geometry_reference.author_cad_coordinate_note: Author X is length, Y width, Z thickness; origin at contact face with key openings below contacts. Y coordinates are not a verified user-view left/right or polarity mapping.
battery_geometry_reference.noncentering_warning: Do not center the 10mm contact pair on the battery width. Author sample pair midpoint is 4mm off the width center. Handedness, polarity and delivered battery dimensions remain unverified.
battery_geometry_reference.status: Author sample measurements, NOT Sony tolerance drawing. Polarity orientation and 1.07mm tip fit unresolved.

procurement_status: Manufacturer dimensional reference verified; exact Taobao seller or interchangeable part not verified
scope: Real manufacturer footprint reference, NOT a released NP-BX1 holder or completed power board contact interface.
